headline: The DevOps and supporting utilities area covers six items all marked ready for release, but the code review could only confirm one of them — the file-path and OneDrive location utility — while the other five could not be settled from the code that was examined.
what_is_there: There is working support for locating a user's OneDrive folder across operating systems and resolving where the app reads and writes files, and the wider configuration uses it. Related sandboxed execution behaviour and task-dependency handling were also visible, though neither matches what the sandbox-preparation or dependency-check tickets describe.
what_is_unclear: Log rotation and cleanup, execution timing and performance tracking, the in-app console display with a hide option, runtime dependency verification, and sandbox environment preparation scripts were all left unconfirmed — in several cases no relevant code surfaced at all, and the analysis only saw a keyword-selected slice of the repository, so this is not evidence the features are absent.
suggested_action: Ask the team to point to where log retention, run timing, the console display, dependency checking and sandbox preparation live, so those five can be checked directly rather than by search.
